tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: In general, the property (magnitudes only) that shows an opposite trend in comparison to other properties across a period is :

solution.text: On moving Left to Right along a period. Atomic Radius <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>⇒</mo></math> decreases. Electronegativity <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>⇒</mo></math>Increases. Electron gainenthalpy <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>⇒</mo></math> Increases. Ionisation Enthalpy <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>⇒</mo></math> Increases.
